rows.label: tlk70000061_02_msg0001
rows.name:
I think giving something a name is a
way of recognizing it for yourself.

rows.label: tlk70000061_02_msg0002
rows.name:
Just as I feel my way toward names for
the emotions born in me each day...

rows.label: tlk70000061_02_msg0003
rows.name:
I want to give names to all the scenes
and events we encounter from now on.

rows.label: tlk70000061_02_msg0004
rows.name:
So that each and every one will
stand as a reminder of the time
I've spent with Rita...
